name: Notes and tasks
author: Brett
description: The one plugin for notes, to-dos and tasks. The Dev Console and AmberX load this same folder and read and write one store on axHub (amberx-notes: lists and items), so both show the same rows; a change on one shows on the other within seconds, no reload. Lists and sub-lists, Inbox, search, export, Today / Upcoming / Todo / All / Done, checklists, subtasks. Voice notes and the Claude files show alongside, read-only. Calendar: day, week, month and agenda views, events, repeats, weekly schedules, due tasks, drag to make, move and resize, plain-English quick add, a multi-pane window with saved layouts, reminders through console alerts, guest lists with RSVP status, invite and chaser emails, a public reply page, two-way Google Calendar sync through axHub. Replaces AmberX's notes and tasks plugins and the console's Todo manager.
